proposed_facts.reason: Canonical declarations establish static-storage register pointers; GXInit unconditionally assigns all four mappings before FIFO, pixel-engine and write-gather setup and later writes through __cpReg. No once-only guard or clearing assignment appears in this translation unit. The explicit compiled-layout disclaimer is appropriate.

The complete canonical GXInit body supports FIFO setup from caller memory, register mapping, shadow and hardware initialization, texture/TLUT-region construction, __GXInitGX invocation and return of persistent FifoObj. Removing the once-only guarantee is a factual correction, not an equivalent rewrite.

The unsigned callback returns NULL for indices at least 20 and otherwise returns a persistent region pointer without mutation. Registration is explicit. GXLoadTlut asserts the result, then issues commands and dereferences it without an ordinary error-return branch, supporting the assertion-dependent qualification.

contradictions.reason: The two once-only claims are resolved by proposals 0 and 1: mapping and initialization execute without an invocation guard. This does not establish that reinitializing an active subsystem is safe.
The consumer-validation claim is resolved by proposal 2. NULL is an explicit callback outcome, but the consumer checks it with an assertion rather than a recoverable runtime branch.

Accepted deferral of the .bss, .sbss and .sdata layout facts and their four associated links. Persistent context, FIFO, region-selection and register-mapping roles are supported and retained, but declarations do not prove compiled membership, ordering or extent. The DWARF comment is not independently inspected DWARF evidence.

Accepted deferral of all four .sdata2 facts and its associated link. Local colors, floating constants and their initialization consumers support source-level semantics, not emitted literal-pool composition, read-only section ownership or section loads. Revision-matched compiled evidence is required.

unresolved: Compiled section membership, ordering, extent and literal-pool composition remain unverified; the accepted deferrals require revision-matched compiled evidence.
Rendered pages report two parse errors and zero substitutions. Canonical evidence, not rendered naming hypotheses, supports this acceptance.
Assertion-dependent exceptional paths do not guarantee recovery, and repeated GXInit safety remains unestablished.
Acceptance covers all three proposed changes and the examined upstream contradictions. Unchanged retained research is inherited, not represented as a new independent audit.
